title: channels__send — input
description: Input schema for the channels__send MCP tool. The tool is non-blocking: it returns as soon as the message is durably accepted by the backing store. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §5.1.

channel.description: Name of the channel to send the message to. Examples: 'ticket:ENGI-0042', 'agent:agent-beta', 'broadcast:status'.

body.description: Opaque message payload. MUST be a JSON object. See CONTRACTS.md §9 for recommended field conventions.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation token supplied by the caller for request-reply matching or at-least-once deduplication. Stored verbatim and echoed back in recv output.

body.subject: Which schema version?
body.question: The task mentions v2 but production is v3. Which do I target?
